Hamas has turned down ceasefire offers, used innocent Palestinians as human shields, and stored weapons in hospitals and schools.

They are a disgusting and cowardly terrorist organization that must be neutralized.

(2/2) This language, which was inspired by LT Alkonis’ unjust treatment and subsequent sacrifice, will lead to more of our servicemembers abroad having the same access to legal services and Due Process as if they were on American soil.

Food security is vital to our national security.

Proud to have fought to fund key nutrition and farm programs in the Agriculture funding bill last month!🌾

As Japan's PM addresses Congress, we shouldn't forget their wrongful treatment of Navy Lt. Ridge Alkonis & the importance of reforming Status of Forces Agreements to protect American service members & their families overseas.

I’m working with colleagues to get this done ASAP.

Proud to work w/ @RepYvetteClarke (D-NY) to introduce the bipartisan Save Our Safety-Net Hospitals Act.

Our bill will protect New York hospitals from Medicaid cuts, keeping our most vulnerable hospitals funded with no additional cost to taxpayers.

https://t.co/X54kvucweA

To protect hospitals like Stony Brook University Hospital from a $53 million cut in 2024, I introduced the bipartisan Save Our Safety-Net Hospitals Act.

My bill safeguards essential health services without burdening taxpayers, ensuring our most vulnerable are supported. https://t.co/oe9p15ZuvW

In the last NDAA, I had the privilege of securing $676 million for the World Trade Center Health Program. This program is crucial in delivering medical monitoring and treatment to 9/11 First Responders and survivors. It was a great honor to contribute to ensuring this vital funding.

Thrilled to announce $1M in funding for flood control and energy upgrades at Huntington’s Wastewater Treatment Plant—vital for keeping our harbor clean. Great to share this with Supervisor Ed Smyth, County Executive Ed Romaine, State Senator Mario Mattera, and Assemblymember Keith Brown.

Proud to have secured $1 million in federal funding for the Village of Southampton's sewer installation project!

https://t.co/l7HPCQe4Nt

Medicare Open Enrollment is happening now through December 7th!

Head to https://t.co/H9mq8ezyvx today and make sure your coverage meets your needs.

🔔Medicare Open Enrollment is almost over! December 7th is the deadline to make updates or changes to your coverage. Act now to make sure your plan is right for you. 
https://t.co/h44pXUdQgZ

Great conversation with Dr. Bill Wertheim of Stony Brook Medicine about advancing healthcare innovation and protecting vital Medicaid funding. My bipartisan Save Our Safety-Net Hospitals Act will help ensure hospitals like Stony Brook get the support they need to care for Long Island’s most vulnerable.

Proud to deliver $1 million in federal funding for the Village of Southampton's new sewer district. Long-term infrastructure projects like this will protect our environment, support economic growth, and keep Suffolk County moving forward.
https://t.co/n5JANdcPrt

This week, I presented my top priority to the House Ways and Means Committee, raising the SALT cap. We Long Islanders aren’t asking for special treatment—we just want our fair share. A recent study shows that New Yorkers get a mere 74 cents for every dollar sent to Washington while other states receive much more than they give. This is about equity and fairness and I won’t stop till we fix the SALT cap.
During National Salute to Veteran Patients Week, we recognize the brave men and women receiving care in VA hospitals. Your sacrifices will never be forgotten. @NorthportVAMC

On this day in 1810, the Navy asked Congress for its first hospitals to care for Sailors. Today, we carry on that mission by improving VA care for our Veterans. Let’s keep fighting for those who fought for us. #VeteransCare #NavalHealthcare #HonoringOurHeroes 🇺🇸⚓

This week I voted to keep the gov’t open, cut waste, protect Social Security & Medicare, raise troop pay, and boost nutrition aid. Credit to Rep. Jared Golden, a Marine Vet, for calling out his party’s false claims about vets' care. Sadly, every House Democrat but him voted no. I’ll keep fighting to cut inflation, secure the border & get Suffolk its SALT relief.

My position on Medicaid—consistent with statements from President Trump and Speaker Johnson—is clear: no extreme cuts, just smart, compassionate reforms. Work rules for able-bodied adults, no coverage for illegal residents & 6-month checks saves $400B & addresses our $2T deficit. https://t.co/baZLHKFz45

Too much SALT may be bad for your diet — but on Long Island, it’s great for your wallet.

That’s why I’m fighting to quadruple the SALT cap to $40K — a fix that helps 92% of my constituents. Now the Senate must deliver real relief for middle-class families. https://t.co/1lFidajcaa

Medicaid spending will still grow by 3% every year under the Big Bill. Don’t let the trolls tell you otherwise. The only reduction is for able-bodied adults who refuse to work, look for work, volunteer, or attend school.

From world-class research to healthcare to higher ed, Stony Brook is a source of 
Suffolk County pride. Great to be at today’s 41-18 win over Fordham with SBU’s new President Andrea Goldsmith. Go Seawolves! 🏈🎉 https://t.co/J1OODLFqTG

Great to join Catholic Health Pres. Patrick O’Shaughnessy at the opening of their new Ambulatory & Urgent Care in Melville. We discussed the Big Bill I backed—protecting Medicare, strengthening Medicaid, & ensuring Suffolk families get quality care when, where & how they need it. https://t.co/KsQaoA1Fty

Don’t buy the scare tactics. The Working Families Tax Cut protects kids, seniors, people w/ disabilities & pregnant women. ✅ Only able-bodied adults who refuse to work lose coverage. Seeing is believing!
Don’t fall for the scare tactics 👉 the Big Bill does NOT change Medicaid coverage for seniors, people with disabilities, pregnant women, or children. https://t.co/qAWdzoR7yn
